problem: The exponents are missing their superscript tags. The text reads "and (n−k)m counts functions into the remaining elements. The k=0 term is nm." Without superscripts these read as the products (n−k)×m and n×m, which is a different (and wrong) quantity. m is already defined as the domain size, so a student will genuinely misread it.
fix: Write "and (n−k)<sup>m</sup> counts functions into the remaining elements. The k=0 term is n<sup>m</sup>."

problem: "add k-fold intersections with sign (−1)k+1" is written without superscript markup, so it reads as (−1)·k + 1 rather than the alternating sign.

The three circles carry only the totals 50, 33 and 20, so the six overlap regions render empty. A student can read the empty overlaps as zero intersections (16, 10, 6, 3), which contradicts the worked example. The caption also says each circle shows numbers divisible by "2, 3 or 5", but the Even circle shows only multiples of 2.
fix: Either fill the overlap regions with 16, 10, 6 and 3, or say in the caption that only the three circle totals are shown and the overlaps are not drawn. Reword the caption to "the Even circle shows 50, the Multiple of 3 circle shows 33, the Multiple of 5 circle shows 20, for numbers from 1 to 100."

problem: "Let Ai be the set of arrangements where item i is in a forbidden position" is loose when one item has several forbidden positions; it is not clear whether Ai is one arrangement-set per item or one per item-position pair.
fix: Say "Let Ai be the set of arrangements in which item i sits in one of its forbidden positions; the derangement case is when each item has exactly one forbidden position."
